features.heading: Capture
text: Greenboard offers a wide range of e-communications integrations from Email, to Slack & Teams, to SMS and iMessage, to domain-specific channels such as marketing platforms and Instant Bloomberg.

features.heading: Supervise
text: Eliminate manual review bottlenecks: Replace random sampling with intelligent AI supervision that catches more issues with fewer false positives.

features.heading: Retain & Search
text: Greenboard's archival system is 17a-4 and WORM compliant and enables detailed search and retrieval for forensic use cases.
E-communications data on the Greenboard platform can be leveraged for advanced use cases in other areas of your compliance program to enable greater efficiency and next-generation supervision.
